name: Conic ETH omnipool Curve reentrancy guard skipped for WETH-listed pools
summary: CurveHandlerV3.reentrancyCheck only probed pools the registry cache lists with the 0xEeee ETH coin, but the Curve v2 rETH and cbETH pools list WETH while paying out native ETH. The attacker re-entered the ConicEthPool from a remove_liquidity ETH callback and ran handleDepeggedCurvePool and withdraw against mid-update Curve balances, draining depositors.
notes: The handler route change installed the skipped check, but the omnipool only became exploitable when its owner listed the WETH-coin rETH and cbETH Curve v2 pools (a market listing the exploit re-entered through), so that listing sets the age.

Loss is the drop in the omnipool's totalUnderlying across the transaction with cncETH supply unchanged, so none of it is a redemption; transfer logs cannot see the Convex-staked positions. It exceeds the attacker's ~1724 ETH because slippage and fees went to third parties.
Separate incident from the crvUSD omnipool loss the same day: that one is a sandwich against spot-balance LP marks, not this reentrancy-guard gap.
